tagline: Pragmatic and steadfast, Giuliana approaches life with the measured patience of one who has learned
bio: Giuliana Moretto navigates Venice's labyrinthine canals and narrow calli with the practiced ease of one born to the rhythm of the tides. Once a gondolier whose songs echoed beneath the city's bridges, she has transitioned from navigating vessels to orchestrating the movement of goods as a respected member of the Compagnia dei Portatori.
